description.value: Honeyberry Farm Market is a small family-run farm stand near Heffley Lake, roughly 40 minutes north of Kamloops on the road to Sun Peaks Resort. The farm specialises in haskap berries (also called honeyberries), offering U-Pick sessions in July alongside spray-free seasonal vegetables, farm-fresh eggs, local wildflower honey, and homemade jams. Set at 944 m elevation with scenic valley views, picnic tables, and livestock to visit, it sits right beside the Heffley Recreation Site and Campground.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms the farm's name, address (6225 Lake Bay Road), and phone ((250) 578-0781), all matching OSM exactly. The site explicitly lists spray-free produce, eggs, jams, and honey as products, confirming a basic-groceries classification. No bike parking infrastructure, water refill, or cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site; the U-Pick page advises visitors to 'bring your own water' while noting water is sold on-site, which does not confirm a free refill.
concerns: Website still displays a 2025 seasonal closure banner ('We are closed for the 2025 season. See you in 2026!') as of the enrichment date (May 2026); the site has not been updated to confirm the 2026 season is open, though the business is clearly a continuing seasonal operation.
OSM tag 'organic=yes' but website only claims 'spray-free and natural' — no mention of certified organic status; OSM tag may be inaccurate.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate seasonal farm market on a popular cycling corridor to Sun Peaks Resort, stocking local produce, eggs, jams, and honey — a useful resupply stop for touring cyclists passing through the Heffley Lake area.
